policy_contract: The DOC public owner selects its own save route; this packet does not apply a common-container sector-layout policy
phase_contract: whole_ns encloses the complete public DOC lifecycle and all local owner drops; split windows cover source open, edit construction, paragraph-0 replacement, commit, and output byte extraction. split_sum_ns is reported with whole_residual_ns and is not required to exhaust whole_ns
diagnostic_contract: profiled-empty calls the feature-gated public open/commit APIs with no-op observers. profiled-clock uses the same APIs and timestamps only semantic DiagnosticEvent callbacks in a fixed-capacity stack; trace validation happens after the timed lifecycle
observer_contract: observer_clock_control_ns measures the fixed-capacity timestamp callback recorder against the expected open-plus-changed-commit event count outside the workflow. It is an observer-cost control, not a subtraction from workflow timings
allocation_ownership_contract: No allocation lane is collected in 0729; the 0728 allocation baseline remains authoritative. Output Vec ownership is retained outside every timing window for oracle validation
